display_long_description:
Bad Saber is a thrilling VR arcade game where your mission is simple: use your badminton skills to destroy oncoming adversaries!  
Armed with your saber, swing with precision and power through 8 action-packed levels—each featuring unique backgrounds, target types, and increasingly intense gameplay.

Unleash drive shots, powerful smashes, and precision hits as you react quickly to birdies that spawn and move dynamically based on the level. As you progress, the challenge ramps up with faster game speed, trickier target patterns, and more frequent spawns.

Whether you're looking to improve your reflexes or just want a fun, energetic workout in VR, Bad Saber delivers endless replay ability and arcade action. Compete for the top spot on the high score leaderboard and prove your skills as the ultimate birdie destroyer!

More levels and content are coming soon, so grab your saber and jump into the action!
